Closed-loop characteristic equation  

1 + Gc(s)Gp(s) = 0   
Gc(s) = Kc(1 + 1/4s) = Kc(4s + 1)/(4s)  
Gp(s) = 1/[(s + 1)(2s + 1)(5s + 1)] = 1/(10s³ + 17s² + 8s + 1)

Multiplying by the common denominator 4s(10s³ + 17s² + 8s + 1) gives  

40s⁴ + 68s³ + 32s² + 4(1 + Kc)s + Kc = 0

Routh array (first column only)

s⁴ : 40  
s³ : 68  
s² : (504 − 40Kc)/17  
s¹ : [ (504 − 40Kc)4(1 + Kc) − 68·17Kc ] /[(504 − 40Kc)]  
    = ( −160Kc² + 700Kc + 2016 ) /(504 − 40Kc)  
s⁰ : Kc

Conditions for all first-column elements > 0:

1. 504 − 40Kc > 0  →  Kc < 12.6  
2. −160Kc² + 700Kc + 2016 > 0  
  → 0 < Kc < 6.357 (positive root of the quadratic)  
3. Kc > 0

Thus the closed loop is stable for 0 < Kc < 6.357; the largest admissible gain is

Kc,max = 6.36 (to 2 d.p.)

For Kc = Kc,max the s¹-row element is zero, giving the auxiliary polynomial  

68s³ + 4(1 + Kc)s = 0  ⇒  68ω² = 4(1 + Kc)  

With Kc = 6.357, ω² = 7.357 / 17 = 0.43218  
ω = 0.657 rad min⁻¹

(c)  Proportional-only control (Kc = 3).  The steady-state error to a unit-step setpoint is  

ess = 1 / [1 + KcGp(0)] = 1 / (1 + 3·1) = 0.25  

Offset = setpoint – output = 0.25.

FINAL (a): 6.36 ­–  
FINAL (b): 0.657 rad/min  
FINAL (c): 0.25 ­–
